title: The molecular basis, genetic control and pleiotropic effects of local gene co-expression.
authors: Ribeiro, Diogo M; Rubinacci, Simone; Ramisch, Anna; Hofmeister, Robin J; Dermitzakis, Emmanouil T; Delaneau, Olivier
one_liner_zh: 该文研究局部基因共表达及其遗传调控，虽涉及ChIP-seq等染色质数据，但核心是基因表达与eQTL分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Nearby genes are often expressed as a group. Yet, the prevalence, molecular mechanisms and genetic control of local gene co-expression are far from being understood. Here, by leveraging gene expression measurements across 49 human tissues and hundreds of individuals, we find that local gene co-expression occurs in 13% to 53% of genes per tissue. By integrating various molecular assays (e.g. ChIP-seq and Hi-C), we estimate the ability of several mechanisms, such as enhancer-gene interactions, in distinguishing gene pairs that are co-expressed from those that are not. Notably, we identify 32,636 expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) which associate with co-expressed gene pairs and often overlap enhancer regions. Due to affecting several genes, these eQTLs are more often associated with multiple human traits than other eQTLs. Our study paves the way to comprehend trait pleiotropy and functional interpretation of QTL and GWAS findings. All local gene co-expression identified here is available through a public database ( https://glcoex.unil.ch/ ).
abstract_zh: 邻近基因常常作为一个群体表达。然而，局部基因共表达的发生率、分子机制及遗传调控远未被充分理解。在此，通过利用49个人体组织和数百个个体的基因表达测量，我们发现局部基因共表达在每种组织中发生于13%至53%的基因中。通过整合多种分子检测（如ChIP-seq和Hi-C），我们评估了几种机制（如增强子-基因相互作用）在区分共表达基因对与非共表达基因对方面的能力。值得注意的是，我们识别出32,636个表达数量性状位点（eQTLs），这些位点与共表达基因对相关联，并常与增强子区域重叠。由于影响多个基因，这些eQTLs比其他eQTLs更常与多种人类性状相关联。我们的研究为理解性状多效性及QTL和GWAS发现的功能解释铺平了道路。此处识别的所有局部基因共表达可通过公共数据库（ https://glcoex.unil.ch/ ）获取。
